name: Dimension 69
source:
One normal day at school turns into a transdimensional shit show after you trip and fall into a machine...

You must use the power to cross dimensional thresholds for the good of the universe!- Which conveniently involves getting it on with a bunch of girls... From plants, to weird Were-mermaids, you'll need to stick your johnson in everything to save the universe from total collapse!

[From [url=https://dussop.itch.io/dimension-69]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在你绊倒并掉进一台机器后，学校里正常的一天变成了一场跨维度的狗屎秀……

为了宇宙的利益，你必须使用这种力量来跨越维度阈值！- 这很方便地涉及到与一群女孩相处……从植物到奇怪的人鱼，你需要将你的约翰逊粘在一切事物上，以拯救宇宙免于彻底崩溃！

[来自[url=https://dussop.itch.io/dimension-69]itch.io[/url]]
